free_tier.stated: Mailbox is byte-unlimited: 'Uživatel může schránku využívat v neomezené velikosti', with a 120,000-message cap that can be raised repeatedly

egress.terms: No metered egress; IMAP/POP access is included

tooling: IMAP (standard clients, rclone 'imap' style tooling via a mail-to-blob shim); no dedicated backend
chaining: One mailbox x 120,000 messages x 35-50 MB per message is a multi-TB theoretical ceiling; identities are the limit
limits_note: 35 MB attach send from web (25 MB mobile), 50 MB receive per message; 120,000 messages/mailbox
reliability_note: message-count cap plus per-message size cap is the real ceiling; touchy about bulk IMAP

evidence.proved: 'Create a new e-mail address with Seznam. Or use your existing one: Gmail, Outlook, or another. / Create @seznam.cz address · Use my existing email · Use phone number'
phone flow: 'In the next step, you will verify your phone number by entering the SMS code'; raw HTML has three <input name="phone" maxlength="3"> prefix boxes plus a disabled suffix box
existing-email flow: 'To verify your email address, enter the verification code we sent to your email'

notes: Mailbox is byte-unlimited: 'Uživatel může schránku využívat v neomezené velikosti', with a 120,000-message cap that can be raised repeatedly
